BiblicalUsage: The judge appears once, in Ezra's commission: the king tells him to appoint judges and magistrates who know the laws of God, to judge all the people beyond the river. A judge who knows God's law is the foundation of a just land.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse ties justice to knowledge: a land is only as just as the law its judges know.
